evidence.title: The Paladins
evidence.description:
Join Darius and Jerico, faithful paladins of opposing deities, as they struggle against monsters invading from the Vile Wedge, a civil war in the North, and a growing unrest fed by prophets and madmen that would tear apart the land for their insidious goals.

This bundle contains the following four novels:

Night of Wolves
Clash of Faiths
The Old Ways
The Broken Pieces

About the Author:

David Dalglish currently lives in rural Missouri with his wife Samantha, and daughters Morgan and Katherine. He graduated from Missouri Southern State University in 2006 with a degree in Mathematics and currently spends his free time playing way too much Warhammer 40k

recorded_ai.author: David Dalglish
recorded_ai.reasoning_summary: Filename and EPUB metadata both point to David Dalglish's "The Paladins" series, bundled as an omnibus containing the four books Night Wolves, Clash of Faiths, The Old Ways, and The Broken Pieces. No provider candidates were returned, and the copyright/first-chapter text contained only cover CSS, so identification rests on filename + embedded title/author, which agree. Omnibus editions often lack ISBNs, consistent with the missing identifiers. Series number left null since this is a collected volume spanning books 1-4.

truth_claims.title: The Paladins Omnibus
truth_claims.author: David Dalglish
truth_claims.note: conf=0.93; Collected edition (also sold as "The Paladins 4-Book Bundle" / "The Paladins Collection" / "The Paladins: Books 1-4") containing all four novels of David Dalglish's Paladins series: Night of Wolves (#1, 2011), Clash of Faiths (#2, 2011), The Old Ways (#3, 2011/2012), and The Broken Pieces (#4, 2012). Note the filename abbreviates book 1 as "Night Wolves"; the actual title is "Night of Wolves." Because it is an omnibus spanning volumes 1-4, it has no single series number (Goodreads lists it as The Paladins #1-4). The Paladins is set in Dalglish's wider Dezrel/Half-Orcs universe, but The Paladins is the tight sub-series.
